signal-green.note: Dark mode #2fae60. Bars, focus rings, checkboxes; never text on light paper.

muted-grey.note: Same as Ink in light mode; dark mode #9a9a9a.

alert-red.note: Offline wordmark and the error banner only.

row-selected.note: The open listing's row. Dark mode #1d3024.

green-text.note: Signal Green wherever text is involved, 5.18:1 on paper. Dark mode same as Signal Green.

scrim.note: Dims the board behind the job sheet and nothing else. Dark mode rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.58). Not elevation.

display-wordmark.purpose: The topbar wordmark only. 13px below the 640px breakpoint.

display-error-code.purpose: The 404 numeral only. 96px at phone width to 160px, at least 2.8 times the section title beneath it.

display-section-title.purpose: Page titles only, sentence case. 24px inside the Statistics column. Never at data-dense sizes.

title-metric.purpose: The large number on a metric tile, tabular figures.

body.purpose: Filters, table cells, panel prose, bar-chart labels. 13 to 14px.

input-touch.purpose: Text fields, selects and textareas on touch screens. 16px is the floor below which iPhone Safari zooms the page on focus.

ui.purpose: Source Sans 3 for controls: buttons, inputs, selects, the view switch, chips and badges. 13px, sentence case.

label.purpose: Column headers, panel titles, the result count. Sentence case, normal tracking; nothing is uppercased by CSS.

motion.name: ticker-scroll
motion.value: translateX(0) to translateX(-50%), linear 70s, paused on hover and keyboard focus
motion.purpose: The topbar ticker. Sits at 80% opacity until pointer or focus is on it; keeps moving with reduced motion on.

motion.name: stats-collapse
motion.purpose: Folding the Statistics column to its 62px rail. Applied before first paint on a returning visit, so it never animates on load.

motion.name: skills-fold
motion.value: grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, 0.25s ease; chevron rotate 180deg 0.25s ease
motion.purpose: The My skills toggle in Best matches, opening downward to its content's own height.

motion.name: status-updating-spin
motion.purpose: The Updating status ring. Keeps turning with reduced motion, since a stopped spinner reads as a hung one.

motion.name: menu-chevron
motion.purpose: Multi-select group chevrons turning to show an expanded country.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Workspace stacks (stats under board); the job sheet goes full-screen; ticker hides; no Statistics toggle.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Filter row wraps to one full-width field per row; wordmark drops to 13px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action. Ink surface, 4px radius, flips to Signal Green on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 2px solid var(--black); background: var(--black); color: var(--white); height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Paper surface, inverts fully to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: 2px solid var(--black); background: var(--white); color: var(--black); height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Apply Link
components.description: The row's primary action, in Green Text so the label keeps its contrast.
components.css: .ds-apply { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--green-text); color: var(--white); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-apply:hover { background: var(--black); } .ds-apply:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A single active filter, e.g. the company filter. Green by default, ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--green-text); color: var(--white); border: 2px solid var(--green-text); border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--black); border-color: var(--black); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Toggle
components.description: A filter-bar dropdown toggle. 1.5px ink border, turns Green Text and bold when a value is picked.
components.html: <button class="ds-ms-toggle">Date posted <svg viewBox="0 0 10 6" width="10" height="6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 1l4 4 4-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button> <button class="ds-ms-toggle ds-on">Israel <svg viewBox="0 0 10 6" width="10" height="6" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 1l4 4 4-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-ms-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; height: 38px; min-width: 120px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--black); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--white); color: var(--black); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ms-toggle.ds-on { color: var(--green-text); border-color: var(--green-text); font-weight: 700; } .ds-ms-toggle:hover { background: var(--hover-bg); } .ds-ms-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The board's search field. Inset green focus ring that reads as a border change, not a halo.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 38px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--black); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--white); color: var(--black); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: View Switch
components.description: All listings, Best matches, Saved. One segmented control; the active segment is filled ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1.5px solid var(--black); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg-btn { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: var(--white); color: var(--black); font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-btn + .ds-seg-btn { border-left: 1.5px solid var(--black); } .ds-seg-btn.ds-active { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); } .ds-seg-btn:not(.ds-active):hover { background: var(--hover-bg); } .ds-seg-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Match Line
components.description: A Best matches row: shared skills as chips on one line, missing skills as faded text, each cut to a +N when out of room.
components.html:
6 of your 14 skillsPythonAWSTerraform+3
Missing skills: Go, Kafka, Redis +2
components.css: .ds-match, .ds-miss { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; font-size: 12px; } .ds-match-count { font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); margin-right: 2px; } .ds-match-chip { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 700; color: var(--green-text); border: 2px solid var(--green-text); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; } .ds-miss { margin-top: 4px; color: var(--grey); opacity: 0.7; } .ds-more { font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 700; color: var(--grey); padding: 1px 2px; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: One Statistics tile. Sharp, laid on the 2px hairline grid rather than bordered itself.
components.css: .ds-metric-grid { display: grid; background: var(--grey-line); border: 2px solid var(--grey-line); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-metric-card { background: var(--white); color: var(--black); padding: 18px 16px; min-height: 116px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-metric-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--grey); } .ds-metric-value { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--green-text); }

components.name: Status Glyph
components.description: Pipeline state. A tick, bang or cross in a ring, or a turning ring while updating. The shape carries the state, not the colour.
components.html: Live
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 13px; color: var(--black); } .ds-status-icon { width: 13px; height: 13px; color: var(--aws-operational); }

narrative.overview:
A market terminal, not a careers site: neutral paper, deep forest-green ink, a single lighter green reserved for the one number or status that matters right now, and a scrolling headline strip up top like a ticker tape. Everything reads as a live instrument panel over a job market, not as a brand experience. Density and legibility win over warmth every time there's a conflict between them. The one indulgence is a single display face (Overused Grotesk, weight 400), kept to two places (the wordmark and the two section titles) so it reads as a signature, not a typeface choice bleeding into body text.

Confirmed visual rejections: no box-shadow used for depth, no decorative color, no third accent hue, no drop-in UI framework look. Every discrete bordered box (buttons, chips, badges, inputs, floating panels) uses a flat 4px radius. See Shapes below for exactly what stays sharp instead (grid-tile cards, the table, dividers) and why.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, two-tone (neutral paper/forest-green ink) surfaces with color used as signal, not decoration
Depth built entirely from 2px hairline grids, never shadows
One bold display face for brand moments; Helvetica for everything data-dense
Light and dark are two deliberately tuned palettes, not a hex inversion
A live-status vocabulary (the ticker, the status glyph) borrowed from terminals/dashboards and service-health pages, not marketing sites

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green marks exactly one "this matters" element at a time. If everything is green, nothing is. It never appears as decoration, only on live status, primary metrics, and the handful of buttons/links that actually do something.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Light and dark mode are two independently tuned palettes, not a hex inversion of each other, but every rule in the system still reads `var(--white)`/`var(--black)` (never a literal hex), so retuning either palette only ever means editing the two `:root` blocks. A hardcoded `#fff`/`#000` anywhere breaks that.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Helvetica (via `--font`) carries everything dense. Source Sans 3 (via `--font-ui`) is for controls: buttons, inputs, selects, the view switch, chips and badges. Overused Grotesk (via `--font-display`) is reserved for the wordmark, section titles, the 404 numeral and the /hero page, which is set in it throughout. No fourth typeface.

rules.name: No forced capitals
rules.body: Nothing is uppercased by CSS, and labels are written in sentence case, status words included ("Live", "Degraded"). Uppercase with wide tracking read as shouting across a dense page, and at 10 to 11px it was the smallest text on it. Where other sections of this file still describe a label as uppercase or tracked, they predate this rule.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The black rules between cards are the only depth cue this design uses. A shadow anywhere is a bug, not a style choice.

dos: Do use 4px radius on every discrete bordered box (see Shapes above); keep it at 0 only for the grid-tile cards, table, and dividers that stay sharp there. Check with the user before adding a new sharp exception, not before rounding something new.
Do build all depth/separation from the 2px black rule grid or a 1px hairline, never a shadow.
Do read every color from a `var(--token)`, never a literal hex, so retuning a palette only ever means editing the two `:root` blocks.
Do keep green to exactly one "this matters most" element at a time.
Do keep Overused Grotesk (display) scoped to the wordmark and the two section titles only, never at data-dense sizes.
Do let `--gutter`'s `clamp()` drive side padding instead of a fixed `max-width` container, so the page keeps scaling at ultra-wide widths.
Do give any element holding an unbreakable-width child (a curl command, a long label) `min-width: 0`. This codebase has hit the grid/flex default-overflow bug repeatedly and the fix is always this.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. Signal Green is the only one; a second dilutes what green means everywhere else.
Don't use Alert Red for anything but an error or a control that undoes or removes (Reset, delete, sign out). Not for emphasis, not for a status (that is the status palette).

Don't introduce a third typeface without folding it into the Two-Voice Rule as a named, scoped exception (see the flagged `.api-path`/`.param` monospace usage in Typography above), an unscoped one-off is exactly how "two voices" quietly becomes three.

Don't reach for `box-shadow` for elevation, ever, even subtly. The one prior violation (a glowing, smoothly-pulsing status dot) was treated as a bug and corrected, not kept as a soft exception. The status glyph is round now and still obeys this: no fill, no shadow, no easing.
